component_rule: Access verification and semantic/entity typing are tracked independently; a verified access route does not imply that the entity itself is a dataset.

records.note: Clima Gerais integrates territorial climate-vulnerability indicators and visualization.
IDE-SISEMA is a state spatial-data infrastructure/catalog-viewer; dataset identity is layer-specific.
AdaptaBrasil is a national climate-impact information and analysis system; indicators are the scientific data objects.
SIRENE is the official Brazilian information system for greenhouse-gas emissions and removals.
CEMADEN is a national monitoring and warning center with multiple observational and alert data families.
PANORAMA/CENSIPAM integrates Amazon territorial monitoring, geospatial data and services.
UrbVerde exposes derived urban socioenvironmental indicators primarily through web visualization/reports.
dados.gov.br is Brazil's national public-data catalog, not one scientific dataset.
GBIF is a global biodiversity data infrastructure; dataset provenance remains publisher-specific.
MapBiomas Brasil is a collaborative data-production initiative with multiple scientific data families.
TerraBrasilis is INPE's geospatial data platform for monitoring programs such as PRODES and DETER.
Programa Queimadas is an operational satellite-monitoring program with multiple data families.
speciesLink integrates records from biological collections; collection provenance remains source-specific.
SiBBr is Brazil's biodiversity information infrastructure; canonical DR route remains generic, so access stays E.
BDiA is an IBGE thematic environmental database; individual layers/collections are the data objects.
CNUC is the official national register of protected areas under SNUC.
SNIRH/HidroWeb is a national water-resources information system and access tool.
BDMEP is INMET's meteorological database of historical station observations.
Google Earth Engine Data Catalog indexes third-party geospatial datasets and provides processing/export infrastructure.
AppEEARS is a data extraction service across multiple federal archives, not a dataset family.
Copernicus Climate Data Store is a climate-data catalog and access service.
WorldClim is a versioned collection of global high-resolution climate surfaces and bioclimatic variables.
CHELSA is a versioned collection of high-resolution climatologies and climate projections.
Protected Planet provides global protected-area and OECM data; editions/data objects retain explicit identity.
IUCN Red List is a global database of species extinction-risk assessments, threats, habitats and distributions.
OBIS is a global marine biodiversity data infrastructure integrating publisher datasets and occurrences.
eBird is a citizen-science project/data platform with observations, checklists and modeled products.
Movebank is a repository/platform for animal tracking and biologging studies; access and licence are study-specific.
NEON is a continental ecological observatory producing standardized field, sensor and airborne data products.
DataONE is a federation for discovery/access across member repositories; dataset provenance remains member-specific.
KNB is an ecological/environmental research-data repository and DataONE member.
PANGAEA is a repository and data publisher for Earth and environmental sciences with dataset-level DOI/provenance.
Dryad is a multidisciplinary curated research-data repository with dataset DOI and open publication.
iNaturalist is a global citizen-science biodiversity observation and identification platform.
Climate Data Guide curates expert descriptions/evaluations and links to climate datasets; it normally does not host them.
FRED is a thematic database of fine-root traits and observations assembled across studies.
SoilGrids is a global modeled soil-property mapping system; raster layers are predictions, not point measurements.
WoSIS is a harmonized global soil-profile database and access service for observed profile/horizon data.
GBIF IPT is publishing software, not an aggregated data-access entity.
TRY is a curated global plant-trait database integrating contributed trait records and source metadata.
BIEN integrates plant occurrences, plots, traits and taxonomy from multiple sources.
AmeriFlux is a network of ecosystem flux towers with site-level carbon, water, energy and meteorological datasets.
FLUXNET is a global flux-tower network/community with harmonized multi-site data collections.
Global Forest Watch is a monitoring/data platform aggregating layers from multiple providers.
Global Carbon Atlas disseminates and visualizes multiple Global Carbon Project data products; series retain source-specific provenance.
EDGAR is a versioned global anthropogenic emissions database with gridded and national time-series products.
Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem is an access/processing infrastructure exposing multiple mission datasets and services.
ESGF is a distributed infrastructure for climate-model data such as CMIP; dataset identity/version remains project-specific.
ILTER is a network of long-term ecological research networks/sites; DEIMS-SDR supports metadata/discovery while datasets may remain external.
ORNL DAAC is a NASA research-data archive for terrestrial biogeochemistry, ecology and environmental dynamics datasets.
Project COSMOS is a bibliometric climate-research database with public analytical products but no open full-database download.
